quotes.text: Rented from this company few times. Took out the Beautiful Wave runner Yamaha machines. Elily Always took care of me and the family! We also got the chance to rent out the boat! All machines are amazing! Def recommend the rentals! Amazing prices and machines are super fast and new

quotes.author: Kingsley Alexander
quotes.text: My wife and i had an amazing time on the water with friends thanks to Toronto Marine Rentals!! The owner Illya was a great personality & had us on our jet skiis quickly. The weather was awesome, my group had a ton of fun, the jet skiis were powerful and easy to operate. Such a great time. Will definitely be returning! 10/10
